notable_absence.finding: This landing/overview page for the entire Search Service names no RBAC role at all - not even a pointer to where one might be documented - despite two other pages in this same batch (create-quick-index.md and view-index-details.md) explicitly requiring the role:fts-admin ('Search Admin') role for their respective tasks. Identical gap already logged against the 7.2 version of this same page (server/7.2/search/search.json): a reader starting at the module's own front door would not learn a role is needed anywhere in the flow.

cross_component_finding: The Vector Search section states directly, in its own words, that Vector Search 'adds a new index type to the Search Service ... known as a Vector Search index' - the module's own overview page independently corroborates the registry's existing decision to keep fts:full-text-search (capability) and index-type:search-vector (a distinct index type within that capability) as separate concepts rather than folding vector search into the text-search capability record; the page draws exactly the line the registry's do-not-confuse note already draws.
cross_product_finding: No forced comparison - this page has no measured Capella twin in this batch's dispatch.
